abstract: Our purpose was to demonstrate the effects of localized radiotherapy on lumbar vertebral bone marrow with the use of quantitative MRI with measurements of T2 relaxation times. Ten patients with early stage testicular seminoma with a history of radiation therapy to a "dog-leg" field including the lumbar vertebrae underwent MR imaging of their lumbar spine using a 0.5 Tesla magnet. Five healthy subjects and two nonirradiated patients were imaged as well. The intervals from the beginning of radiotherapy to MRI examination varied from 1.5 to 52 months, and the radiation dose ranged from 3000-4200 cGy. The T2 relaxation times of the lumbar vertebral bone marrow and subcutaneous fat were calculated for each subject. Postirradiation bone marrow in irradiated seminoma patients exhibited significantly longer T2 relaxation times than nonirradiated bone marrow in controls (71.1 vs. 63.6 ms, p = 0.047, t-test). The differences between the T2 relaxation times of bone marrow and subcutaneous fat for each subject allowed for even better differentiation between irradiated patients and controls (10.4 vs. 0.4 ms, p = 0.0004, t-test). Postirradiation bone marrow had significantly longer T2 relaxation times than subcutaneous fat in irradiated patients (N = 10, 71.1 vs. 60.7 ms, p = 0.00009, t-test), while nonirradiated bone marrow had T2 relaxation times not statistically different from subcutaneous fat in nonirradiated subjects (N = 7, 63.6 vs. 63.2 ms). Measurements of T2 relaxation times of bone marrow enabled us to differentiate between irradiated seminoma patients and controls. Postirradiation bone marrow undergoes late radiation effects resulting in longer T2 relaxation times than nonirradiated bone marrow and subcutaneous fat.
abstract_ja: 本研究の目的は、局所放射線療法が腰椎椎体骨髄に及ぼす影響を、定量的MRIによるT2緩和時間の測定によって示すことであった。精巣セミノーマの早期患者10例で、腰椎を含む「ドッグレッグ」照射野による放射線療法の既往があった。対照として健常者5名と非照射患者2名もMRI撮像を受けた。放射線療法開始からMRI検査までの期間は1.5～52か月、照射線量は3000～4200 cGyであった。腰椎椎体骨髄と皮下脂肪のT2緩和時間をそれぞれ算出した。照射後の骨髄は、非照射対象の骨髄より有意に長いT2緩和時間を示した（71.1対63.6ms、p=0.047）。骨髄と皮下脂肪のT2緩和時間の差は、照射患者と対照をさらによく区別した（10.4対0.4ms、p=0.0004）。照射患者では、照射後骨髄が皮下脂肪より有意に長いT2緩和時間を示した（71.1対60.7ms、p=0.00009）。一方、非照射対象では骨髄と皮下脂肪のT2緩和時間に有意差はなかった（63.6対63.2ms）。T2緩和時間の測定により、照射を受けたセミノーマ患者と対照を区別することができた。照射後の骨髄には晩期放射線影響が生じており、その結果、非照射の骨髄や皮下脂肪より長いT2緩和時間を示す。
